name: Night Light
description: A bedtime night light for a child's room. As a screensaver it plays gentle sleepy music while the screen drifts through soft colours, then fades to a dim warm light for the rest of the night.
author: heazlewood

settings.title: Colour show length
settings.description: How long the colours and music play before the night light fades to the warm sleep light.

settings.title: Colours
settings.description: The set of colours the screen drifts through.

settings.title: Colour speed
settings.description: How quickly one colour melts into the next.

settings.title: Colour brightness
settings.description: How bright the colours are. They also dim a little as the show goes on.

settings.title: Fade to sleep light
settings.description: How long the colours and music take to fade into the sleep light.

settings.title: Sleep light colour
settings.description: A warm orange or amber is kindest to sleep.

settings.title: Sleep light brightness
settings.description: How bright the sleep light glows for the rest of the night.

settings.title: Music
settings.description: What plays during the colour show. The music is made up as it plays, so it never repeats exactly.

settings.title: Volume
settings.description: Music volume, on top of the device's media volume.

settings.title: During the sleep light
settings.description: What happens to the sound once the sleep light comes on.
